mapper_rules.necessary_recovery_definition: earlier failed calculate with the same alpha-renamed expression shape, followed by a source-proved necessary successful calculation; not inferred mental intent

qualification_rules.actual_history_policy: SFT role only; complete original public request/response history and settled real provenance; replay every original tool call, including errors, byte-for-byte. No removed prefix, inferred call, replacement output or extra prose claims.
qualification_rules.author_path_limits: 32 linear steps; exact author evidence text/row binding; unique data leaf match
qualification_rules.author_path_unit_policy: An unlabelled same-metric table row may carry one shared opaque unit, cancellable only in a same-unit ratio. No guessed USD, amount Final, cross-metric cancellation or conflicting column/text scales. Percent/currency/count conversions are explicit.
qualification_rules.collection_policy: Freeze rules first; only after all slots in the explicitly preregistered study scope (8 per task) complete does the inventory controller assess the whole batch. Six train and two sealed slots never exchange roles. Single-episode output is a candidate decision, not material-pool admission.
qualification_rules.delivery_policy: A source-proved declarative Final program may pass without online calculate. Offline program execution is explicitly separate from actual tool execution.

execution_protocol_binding.system_and_tools: same shared selectors as live execution

qualification_rules.known_contradiction: invalid, retained in the original inventory
qualification_rules.numerical_policy: Program must have the proved source dependency; Final and actual calculation must be compatible after explicit declared scale conversion and official five-place rounding, not an adjustable tolerance. Native metrics are not rewritten.
qualification_rules.private_reference_policy: Author table_i anchor plus program must agree with independently bound question/table dependency, OR an author-anchored derivation must bind every data leaf uniquely to original table/text with explicit metric, period and compatible unit evidence. Author labels are trusted task-semantics evidence, not universal proof of all legal solutions. Reference disagreement or unsupported alternatives remain unknown.
qualification_rules.scope: public explicit-period applicability or uniquely source-bound author-anchored derivation
qualification_rules.source_equivalence: same bound numeric leaves and canonical dependency DAG, not merely equal_program or equal final value; commutative and associative add/multiply order ignored
qualification_rules.source_policy: Unique exact normalized metric row and year columns; numeric period values distinct; currency/scale explicit in table header, row or global public amounts declaration. This narrow public-only applicability path does not infer text evidence or periods. The separate author-anchored path below may prove original text sources.

role_plan.selection_basis: seeded source-group hashes, never model success or reference values
